'''Thomas McManus''' played Star Wars CCG at the Danger Room in Anderson, Indiana, and wrote two reports on its tournaments for the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] fan site. He went 3–2 at the [[September 1999 Anderson tournament]], his second sanctioned constructed event,<ref name="cec-r1">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/report1.html Anderson, In (9/25/99)], Thomas McManus, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030123/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/report1.html Internet Archive]</ref> and finished 3rd at the [[November 1999 Anderson tournament]].<ref name="cec-r3">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/report3.html Anderson, In (11/13/99)], Thomas McManus, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030133/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/report3.html Internet Archive]</ref>
